title: Stage B injection library without an iPhoneOS SDK: fetch the donor's tracked prebuilt/userland/libhakios.dylib (and prebuilt/SHA256SUMS) at the pinned donor SHA 87bf485 into references/hakios, record hashes, and inspect it statically (Mach-O header, load commands, install name, imports, strings, constructor) against references/hakios/userland/src/inject.c, so that the project knows what a Stage B run would load into backboardd before any run. Nothing is executed and nothing is claimed about the phone
acceptance: The note records the donor SHA, the blob hashes of the fetched files (checked against prebuilt/SHA256SUMS when it lists them), file size, Mach-O type/arch/flags, install name, dependent libraries, the undefined imports and the constructor, and states what it does NOT establish: the dylib is a binary built by the donor, not reproduced from inject.c on this host, so source and binary are related only by the strings and addresses that can be compared.

Every string, 20F66 shared-cache address and sysctl/device path in inject.c that can be searched in the binary is compared row by row; each row says found / not found / not comparable, never 'matches' from a symbol name. Any import or string absent from inject.c is listed as unexplained.

The note ends with a decision: either the prebuilt dylib may be staged into a Stage B small root by a later host task (with the residual risk named) or it must be rebuilt from source first; the Apple SDK / open-header route stays listed as the alternative.
steps: Fetch the pinned blobs into references/hakios (sparse add) and hash them
Compare with inject.c row by row
Write the note and the decision
